Create a team

get
https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/teams

Creates a team within the current workspace.

Query Params
opt_fields
array of strings

This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include. Properties can include nested fields. To learn more, see the input/output options guide.

opt_fields
boolean

Provides “pretty” output.
Provides the response in a “pretty” format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging.

Body Params

The team to create.

data
object

Full object requires scope: teams:read

A team is used to group related projects and people together within an organization. Each project in an organization is associated with a team.
